name.en: Flexible lightweight CIGS film (Miasole FLEX-03NS series)
name.es: Flexible y ligero, pelicula CIGS (serie Miasole FLEX-03NS)

description.en: Thin flexible CIGS laminate, glass-free, for curved or weight-limited roofs. Reference: Miasole FLEX-03NS (1709 x 348 mm, 75-90 W, datasheet 2019). The organic (OPV) film is a separate entry (opv_flexible). A glass-free mono-Si flexible module (Sunman eArc) is kept as a second reference in mechanical_ratings.
description.es: Laminado CIGS delgado y flexible, sin vidrio, para cubiertas curvas o con limite de peso. Referencia: Miasole FLEX-03NS (1709 x 348 mm, 75-90 W, ficha de 2019). La pelicula organica (OPV) es una entrada aparte (opv_flexible). Un modulo flexible de silicio monocristalino sin vidrio (Sunman eArc) se conserva como segunda referencia en mechanical_ratings.

typical_use: Lightweight roofs, curved surfaces and roof membranes where framed glass modules are not suitable; adhesive-backed version listed.

cell.type: CIGS thin film on flexible substrate
cell.note: Datasheet: 'CIGS flexible module'. Substrate, cell count and cell size not stated.

layers.name: Flexible CIGS laminate
layers.material: CIGS flexible laminate, layers not stated individually

layers.name: Adhesive backing
layers.note: Derived: 2.5 mm with adhesive minus 1.6 mm without adhesive (both datasheet values). Not a stated layer thickness.

parts.name: Junction box
parts.note: Length and width not stated; height max 17 mm (datasheet).

geometry.description: Single flexible element 1709 x 348 mm. Thickness 1.6 mm without adhesive and 2.5 mm with adhesive (datasheet); the 0.9 mm adhesive layer is derived. Junction box size not stated beyond 17 mm maximum height; not modelled.
geometry.coordinate_system: x along module long side, y along short side, z up through thickness; origin at module front-left corner; mm. Here z=0 is the top of the laminate face and z grows toward the mounting surface.

mechanical_ratings.weight_note: 1.1 kg without adhesive, 1.3 kg with adhesive (datasheet)

reference_sunman_earc_mono_si_glass_free.glass_replaced: yes, by a laminate (glass replaced per brochure)

mechanical_ratings.status_note: values transcribed from the Miasole datasheet; status unverified unless marked

unverified_items: Substrate and laminate layer stack not stated; only total thickness is sourced.
Adhesive backing thickness (0.9 mm) is derived from two datasheet values, not stated.
Junction box length and width not stated (height max 17 mm).
Cable cross-section and length not stated.
Datasheet is a 2019 Japanese-language sheet for the FLEX-03NS series (variants 75-90 W); the current product line may differ.
Sunman eArc values belong to a different (mono-Si) product and are a reference only.

sources.title: FLEX-03NS series CIGS flexible module datasheet (Japanese, 2019)
